section_summary.extract_value: This section presents descriptive statistics comparing the current sample of Black women on body appreciation (BAS) and eating disorder symptomatology measures with previously published college samples. The current sample reported significantly higher average BAS scores than the primarily White development sample, and lower scores on most eating disorder measures (EDE-Q-R and EDE-Q-EC), with no significant differences on other subscales.

section_summary.extract_value: This section presents descriptive statistics for a study examining body appreciation and eating disorder symptomatology in a sample of Black women college students. The current sample reported significantly higher Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) scores compared to the primarily White development sample, and lower eating disorder symptomatology scores on most subscales (EDE-Q-R and EDE-Q-EC) compared to a previously published sample of undergraduate women.
